justification: Inspected [TextElementIteratorsFactory.java](javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation/TextElementIteratorsFactory.java) and [LexicalPreservingPrinter.java](javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation/LexicalPreservingPrinter.java). EmptyIterator is a tiny nested utility with no fields and only two methods: `hasNext()` always returns false and `next()` always throws, and it is only used as the empty return path in `tokensPreceeding(...)`. There is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large size, or low cohesion in this class.
